description: Three-node ring first positive signed-loop benchmark.
notes: Phase 28 keeps the broadened held-out loop set fixed from Phase 24/26/27.
The remaining half-share style choice inside the lower-order normalizers is replaced by compactness ratios from generator-side geometry.
The gap, boundary, and area lower-order terms are now controlled by boundary, transport, and boundary-transport compactness together with a symmetry-averaged area compactness channel.
The higher-order coefficients remain generator-derived from those lower-order coefficients and canonical train-row moments.
No response regression is introduced in this step.
